snippet.title: GodsTV - Official Demo Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase
snippet.description: Check out the trailer for GodsTV. Smash for Fame in This Madcap 90’s Killfest. Meet a vibrant cast of characters in this frantic action game with zero chill where Gods feed off of fame... And fame is a weapon. GodsTV will be available on PC, and a new demo is coming to Steam in April 2026.
